hero.title: Financial tracking, designed for clarity.
hero.description: Fintrack helps you track income, expenses, and financial patterns with structured records and clear insights. Built for people who value control over their financial data, so you always know where your money goes and why.

trust.privacy_desc: Your financial data stays yours. No third-party tracking. Fintrack does not sell, share, or analyze your data for advertising or third-party services. No ads, no trackers.
trust.security_desc: Fintrack uses industry-standard encryption and secure backend practices to protect sensitive information at every stage with regular security audits and updates.
trust.reliability_desc: Financial records need to be accurate and dependable. Fintrack focuses on consistent and stable performance, predictable behavior, and transparent calculations.

features.title: Core Capabilities
features.subtitle: Essential ways for managing your financial data with precision and clarity, while keeping your information private and protected.
features.transaction_desc: Maintain organized financial records with categorized income and expenses. Clear data structure for easy reference.
features.analytics_desc: Understand where your money goes with visual breakdowns and category-based analytics. Identify trends over time.
features.receipt_desc: Upload receipts and extract transaction details automatically. Save time on manual data entry.
features.account_desc: Sign up in seconds with email or use Google, GitHub, or Microsoft. Set your preferred currency and start tracking.

how_it_works.title: How Fintrack Works
how_it_works.subtitle: Start tracking your finances in these hassle-free and straightforward steps:
how_it_works.step1_desc: Sign up in seconds. Set your preferred currency and financial tracking preferences.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Add income and expenses manually or scan receipts. Categorize transactions for organized records.
how_it_works.step3_desc: View spending breakdowns, track patterns, and generate reports. Make informed financial decisions.

philosophy.title: Product Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: FinTrak is designed with a strong emphasis on usability, transparency, and efficient financial management. Its features are built to support accurate record-keeping, clear presentation of financial data, and direct user control over how information is tracked and organized. Rather than relying on excessive automation or visually heavy dashboards, FinTrak focuses on structured data, practical insights, and predictable workflows, making financial tracking consistent, reliable, and easy to maintain over time.
philosophy.principle1_desc: We focus on presenting your financial data in a way that's easy to understand. No confusing jargon or overwhelming interfaces.
philosophy.principle2_desc: Our analytics show you what matters: spending patterns, category breakdowns, and trends that help you make decisions.
philosophy.principle3_desc: You decide how to categorize and track your finances. FinTrak supports your workflow, not the other way around.
